Card Q&A.q: How does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect work, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: It means the total number of cards in both you and your opponent's security stacks. For example, if you have 3 cards in your security stack and your opponent has 2 cards in their security stack, the total security cards will be 5 cards.
Card Q&A.q: What does "total cards in both players' security stacks" in this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect mean?

Effect: [When Digivolving][When Attacking][Once Per Turn] By trashing the top card of your security stack, you may play 1 yellow level 4 or lower card from your hand without paying the cost. Digimon played by this effect gain ＜Rush＞ for the turn.
[All Turns] All of your yellow Digimon gain ＜Barrier＞.
[Opponent's Turn] All of your opponent's Digimon with levels greater than or equal to the total cards in both players' security stacks gain ＜Security A. -2＞.
